long_entries.rule: Stopping volume at demand - high volume, narrow spread, close up
No Supply bar - low volume down bar in uptrend
Test bar - low volume at support, closes up
Buying climax - extreme volume at bottom with reversal
Effort to fall with no result - high volume no down move

short_entries.rule: Upthrust - high volume up bar closes on low
No Demand bar - low volume up bar in downtrend
Selling climax - extreme volume at top with reversal
Effort to rise with no result - high volume no up move

exits.rule: Opposing VSA signal (upthrust after long, stopping volume after short)
Volume dries up in trend direction
